name: When should I consider upgrading to easy grip door hardware?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider upgrading to easy grip door hardware?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider upgrading to easy grip door hardware if you are experiencing difficulty operating traditional doorknobs, particularly if you or family members have arthritis, carpal tunnel syndrome, or other hand mobility issues. It's also an excellent upgrade for aging-in-place renovations, enhancing home accessibility, or simply seeking a more convenient and modern door solution. Many choose to upgrade during a home renovation or when replacing existing doors to improve functionality and aesthetics.
acceptedAnswer.description: Upgrade to easy grip hardware if you have difficulty with doorknobs, for aging-in-place, improved accessibility, or during renovations for convenience and a modern look.
